Operations Command Center & Event Autopilot

Orchestrate complex banquets, weddings, and high-volume service with multi-stage execution timelines, vendor readiness tracking, and incident manager alerts.

🤖 AI Event Autopilot
Confirmed BEOs automatically generate execution timelines, F&B milestones, vendor readiness tasks, and kitchen prep board items.
🚨 Real-Time Incident Manager
Staff and managers log incidents with readiness-blocking alerts (e.g. A/V failure, vendor delay) directly on the command center board.
📷 Photo-Verified Checklists
Opening, mid-day, and closing checklists require photo upload verification for high-standard quality control.

AI Natural Language Engine & Invoice Vision

AI-driven search, automated unstructured roster imports, bottle receipt vision scanning, and intelligent labor forecasting.

AI Natural Language Search

Real-Time Team Live Chat & Role Channels

Instant 1-on-1 DMs, encrypted media sharing, and auto-generated channels that sync automatically with active roles and daily shift schedules.

💬 Auto-Created Shift Crew Channels
Automatically creates daily shift channels (`#Crew - Friday (Jul 31)`) containing only the staff scheduled to work that day.
👥 Auto-Synced Role Channels
Maintains role channels (`#Role - Bartender`, `#Role - Kitchen`) synced automatically with roster titles.
🔄 Interactive Shift & Swap Cards
Embed shifts or swap requests directly inside chat threads for 1-tap manager review and approval.
